text: Your agent is out on a viewing, and every phone in the office is ringing.
So I set up a Voho receptionist for a Riyadh property agency, in Saudi Arabic.
It gets the listings, the rents, and one rule: answer in one short sentence.
Then I called it, looking for a flat.
It found a flat in my budget and booked the viewing, with nobody at the desk.
Every buyer gets an answer, even when you're out. Try it at app dot voho dot A I.
